claims.location: source name, comment[data file], characteristics[biological replicate], genotype, factor value[genotype], rows 1-12
claims.value: Six wild-type controls and six cardiac PKP2 knockouts
claims.evidence: Deposited Samples_overview.xlsx gives twelve rows: six Control followed by six PKP2cKO. Its filenames repeat S01/S2-A1 but retain unique terminal run IDs 7172-7183. Those IDs map one-to-one to twelve actual .d roots verified from the raw_files.7z file index and to twelve matching pepXML names in the accession-matched PRIDE file list. PRIDE project description equates controls with wild-type mice.
PRIDE project and preparation protocol describe left atria from mice; overview tissue column says Atria for all twelve runs.

claims.location: comment[instrument], acquisition and cleavage agent, rows 1-12
claims.evidence: The linked publication's Methods identify the timsTOF Pro and on-bead trypsin digestion. PRIDE records DDA, and vendor raw directory names contain DDA. The PRIDE structured Agilent 6220 instrument dropdown conflicts with the protocol and publication.

claims.location: comment[modification parameters] and comment[fragment mass tolerance], rows 1-12
claims.value: Fixed carbamidomethylated cysteine; variable oxidized methionine, N-terminal acetylation and STY phosphorylation; 20 ppm maximal MS/MS search tolerance
claims.evidence: The linked publication's Methods (page 8) explicitly describe the search settings for this dataset's phosphoproteomic analysis.

limitations: The deposited overview has a copy/paste filename error: all rows show S01_S2-A1. Actual vendor directory names were recovered from the 7z index and matched by unique trailing run IDs to the overview and the twelve deposited pepXML names.

The full 17 GB archive was not downloaded. Its 7z signature header and final 1 MB index region were read through HTTP byte ranges and listed with bsdtar; the twelve vendor roots are saved in archive_roots.json.
Sample age, sex, and mouse strain are not mapped to individual runs in the available record; no values were inferred from the study topic.
PRIDE names immunoprecipitation of RyR2 but does not give an ontology-backed enrichment field in this annotation.
